Their specialties include family services, substance abuse treatment, and outpatient drug rehab. With these services, they aim to provide holistic care that addresses the underlying issues contributing to an individual’s mental health challenges.

Connect Cognitive Therapy offers a variety of therapies, including individual therapy and counseling, family therapy and counseling, and group therapy and counseling. They also offer holistic therapies such as yoga and meditation, art and nature therapy, and nutritional counseling to help individuals achieve a balanced and healthy lifestyle.

With a commitment to evidence-based practices, Connect Cognitive Therapy provides a safe and supportive environment for individuals to work through their mental health challenges. They strive to help each person develop the skills and tools needed to manage their mental health and live a fulfilling life.
